answer: Make plume the lone branch map binding key, route and first output; every quill is one clone and must collide there. The kth quill activates only with k disjoint branches countersigning in one epoch; a branch backs one live quill per epoch and burns k ripple to plume. Launching n quill at once needs n(n+1)/2 distinct branches and Σk² ripple; reuse is impossible. It fails if plume merges branches, countersigns replay, or ripple moves.
